g.text: High-Performance Biometeorological Ingestion, Mathematical Pipeline, Explainable AI RAG & Native Mobile PWA Layer
📱 TIER 1: CLIENT PRESENTATION LAYER (React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + TailwindCSS + Capacitor 8 Mobile Engine)
Female Voice TTS, Speech Mic, Audit Log
Leaflet OSM, Dynamic Overlays, Zustand Store
⚡ TIER 2: BACKEND-FOR-FRONTEND (BFF) GATEWAY & LRU CACHING LAYER (Express REST API, Port 4000)
Normalized lat/lon grid indexing with sub-2ms hit latency
12-minute meteorological sliding TTL with cache eviction
Automatic retry backoff and fallback data mocks on upstream downtime
Stull Wet-Bulb equation, Solar globe proxy,
Wave energy flux (P ≈ 0.49 * Hs² * Tp kW/m),
🧠 TIER 3B: EXPLAINABLE AI & GROUNDED RAG PIPELINE
Injects active GPS weather, persona profile,
allergies, and active district alert triggers
Instant audio halt on new prompts/mic taps
knowledge chunks, and tool execution history
🌐 TIER 4: UPSTREAM METEOROLOGICAL TELEMETRY & GOVERNMENT SENSORS CATALOG
